{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99)
qa_orders = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)

# Drop QA orders from the dataset
df_no_qa = df[~qa_orders]

# Check: are there any QA orders left?
print("Remaining QA orders after drop:", (df_no_qa['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())

# Now compute conversion rate by customer_segment
total_by_segment = df_no_qa['customer_segment'].value_counts()
converted_by_segment = df_no_qa.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = converted_by_segment / total_by_segment

# Sort by conversion rate descending
conversion_rate_sorted = conversion_rate.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Print results
conversion_rate_sorted"}
